title: Authoring draft
description: A page draft an external agent returns for one documentation gap. The body carries [[kind:ref]] citation markers, and every explicit unknown and reviewer question the task names is repeated here.

version.description: The only draft version this engine reads.

item.description: The public surface id the draft documents, such as symbol:parseWidget.

pageType.description: The page type the task recommended.

title.description: The page title, written to front matter.

description.description: The meta description, written to front matter when present.

slug.description: The stable output URL, under the site base, with a trailing slash.

block.description: The block id the first heading declares.

body.description: The Markdown body, with [[kind:ref]] citation markers on its normative claims.

limitations.description: The limitations the page states; the task's limitations must survive here.

unknowns.description: The explicit unknowns carried forward from the task.

questions.description: The questions a human reviewer must answer.
